messages:
mona (product): dropping a quick mock for the prompt-sets -> evals scorecard compact list. goal = faster triage for test-suite owners: surface regressed count, median confidence, and an example failure snippet. https://invision.app/mock (preview)
ellie (design): i pushed a compact card layout — each row shows: test name, tags, small heat dot for regressions, inline 1-line failure excerpt, right-side action chevron. idea is quick skim with one key action: Accept/Investigate.
raj (frontend): looks good. implementation questions: are tags filterable inline? and will the heat dot be color-only? we should not rely on color alone.
ellie (design): tags are interactive chips; for the heat indicator we'll add an icon + color + tooltip (and `aria-label` with status).
oscar (a11y): a few quick nits from the initial mock: 1) the failure excerpt is truncated with ellipsis but not keyboard-expandable; 2) screen reader sees row as just a link, not a composite control — should be role=button group or listitem with aria-describedby referencing the snippet; 3) contrast of the heat dot at small sizes falls below 3:1.
mona (product): on the expand: we don't want full expanded rows by default. propose a small inline "...more" button with `aria-controls` to open an inline drawer. default tab stop should be the primary action.
raj (frontend): inline drawer is fine. performance note: opening many inline drawers simultaneously will bloat the DOM. better to lazy-render the drawer content on first open.
ellie (design): copy options for primary action: "Accept" vs "Approve test" vs "Mark as fixed". which is clearest for audit/history?
oscar (a11y): prefer verbs that map to audit log text exactly, so use the terminology we already have in backend events. what does the event name say?
mona (product): backend event uses `mark_approved`. recommend "Approve test" to keep product + event consistent. also add secondary action "Investigate" which opens the eval-run view.
raj (frontend): notes for screen reader announcements: when approval happens, we should announce "Test X approved" via a polite live region and move focus to the toast. avoid shifting focus away from the action button.
oscar (a11y): make toast dismissable with keyboard and include a visible `aria-label` on the Undo button. also for counts, don't rely on parentheses — VoiceOver reads them oddly. format: "Approve selected — 4" or separate `span.sr-only` like we discussed earlier.
ellie (design): interaction question: bulk selecting across pages — do we allow select-all-across-filter? pm input?
mona (product): for now limit to current page selection. bulk across filter is a bigger product decision (scope creep). add a tooltip on the selection checkbox to explain limitation.
ci-bot: preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/evals/compact-scorecard (build 8123) · tests: 184 passing, 6 flaky
raj (frontend): will prototype with: `role=list` containing `role=listitem` rows, each row has `aria-labelledby` for test name and `aria-describedby` for failure snippet. selection announcer will update `aria-live` text: "4 tests selected".
oscar (a11y): also ensure keyboard order: checkbox -> primary action -> chevron. not: checkbox -> chevron -> action. users should be able to approve by keyboard without extra tabbing.
ellie (design): final microcopy confirm: confirmation modal heading = "Approve tests"; body = "This will mark X tests as approved in the selected prompt set." primary CTA = "Approve tests" (danger style). secondary = "Cancel".
mona (product): add undo toast with copy: "X tests approved — Undo" and include analytics event `bulk_approve_undo`.
oscar (a11y): i'll run NVDA & VoiceOver on the preview and post any live issues.
ellie (design): thanks y'all — please drop 1-line verification after testing: keyboard nav, SR announce on select, contrast for heat dot, copy matches "Approve tests". aiming for a11y sign-off by tomorrow.
